description: Humanizer PRO is a web service for rewriting draft text to sound more natural, scanning text for AI-style signals, and tracking word-balance usage across plans and integrations. It also offers hosted integrations for AI assistants and workflow tools using the same account balance.
summary: texthumanizer.pro exposes an OAuth-protected streamable HTTP MCP server at `/mcp` and a documented REST API that uses bearer-token authentication; no GraphQL API or standalone first-party CLI was found.
